message.reasoning_content: Dig It was Martin? Phil Spector produced Let It Be tracks except... Dig It was produced by George Martin actually. Let It Be: two were Spector, one was Paul (Maggie Mae?). Dig It credited to Martin. One After 909, I've Got a Feeling, Dig It — Glyn Johns/Martin. Dig It commonly credited George Martin. What You're Doing is Beatles self-produced. Dig It is the answer.
